_comment: Coverage matrix for the shared Carve spec corpus (spec/tests/corpus/*.crv). Every NN-slug base category must appear in covered or skip; the coverage-matrix test fails otherwise so a new spec category forces a classify decision. covered = grammar parses every file in the category with no ERROR/MISSING node. skip = at least one file currently produces an ERROR/MISSING node; reason records the unmodeled construct (a grammar gap to surface, not to hack around).

skip.11-fenced-code: Code-fence info string with bracket label ([NPM]) or key=value attributes (title="x") is not modeled; bare-language fences are covered.
skip.13-admonitions: Admonition block with a quoted custom title (::: tip "Pro Tip") / non-builtin type is not modeled.
skip.44-generic-divs: Div fence carrying an attribute block (::: {.sidebar}) is not modeled; plain named divs are covered.
skip.47-raw-blocks: Raw block with an =FORMAT info string (```=html) is not modeled.
skip.64-attribute-edge-cases: Attribute edge cases (nested braces in a quoted value, escaped quote inside a value, block attribute line before a heading, special char in a class name) are not modeled.
skip.66-inline-span: Inline span with an unparseable attribute payload ([x]{???}) is not modeled.
skip.76-paragraph-interruption: A div fence (:::note) interrupting a paragraph is not modeled.
skip.81-list-lazy-continuation: A div nested inside a list item is not modeled.
skip.87-list-item-attributes: An attribute block at the very start of a list item ({.c} text) is not modeled.
skip.88-line-blocks: Line blocks (::: | ...) are not modeled at all.
skip.98-table-row-attributes: Table row attributes ({.head} glued to the closing pipe) are not modeled.
